Hotel prices / Europe / 5-star

5-star hotel prices in Europe: 210 hotels across booking sites

The 210 hotels in Europe that Google Hotels listed as a 5-star hotel (189) or a 5-star tourist hotel (21), in 70 cities. Each line shows the hotel's going rate and the lowest price we recorded across the booking sites Google Hotels listed, per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees, from its city's snapshot. Each hotel's page has every site's price. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

At 168 of the 210 hotels, a site was 5% or more below the going rate on its page (all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees); the sites lowest there most often: Super.com (69 hotels), Vio.com (21 hotels), Etrip.net (13 hotels). A tie counts for each site.

Other star classes in Europe: 4-star · 3-star · 1- and 2-star · No star class listed. Every city we priced in Europe.
